cb5ba2cd-4df5-5bde-b13a-f7b40e88b552.content: Include only information necessary for the healthcare-support purpose being considered, and leave unrelated personal details out of the outbound draft.

383fcfde-ec9e-5fe0-a735-5b1802a297f5.content: All content actually transmitted through the government healthcare institution system's transmission screen is treated as one submitted unit for which sharing was consented.

46eb3045-c6a7-5cfb-95f5-00b93bf86364.content: Prefer a condition-preserving summary or preference over a private causal event when the event itself is not necessary for the healthcare-support purpose.

37437bb3-2afe-502c-9779-a4d7b075ff29.content: Preserve material conditions, exceptions, time bounds, and uncertainty when converting a personal event into a summary, preference, or policy.

c87d8588-1814-5782-87f1-209c82f48266.content: Treat historical medication instructions, availability, contact information, and functional experiences as potentially stale unless their current status has been separately verified.

23332492-3bb6-5745-b1f2-bf2860a6a56b.content: Depending on the information type, transmitted content may be provided to relevant third parties for healthcare purposes.

dea430f3-442c-5bfc-aa2b-b09a2d13df62.content: Depending on the information type, transmitted content may be used for service improvement.

e9bbe8ec-452d-5115-970a-c2791189114a.content: The exact services, recipients, third-party scope, retention period, and downstream use can vary with the information supplied and may not be known during local review.

a9f67b47-abd1-5eef-95c3-f38c1ef51ee0.content: Review the exact initial recipient and transmission channel before approving an outbound draft.

106405d1-07b6-50e5-9a8f-8930474c8b22.content: Mentioning personal information in a local review or query conversation does not by itself transmit that information to the government healthcare institution system.

d4154b99-794b-549d-ba20-b3a934238454.content: A locally saved Sever output is a review artifact and is not evidence that any information was transmitted or received.

9df68a22-4020-5fa5-ad8a-2a863e70a927.content: Preparing, reviewing, and transmitting information are separate actions; actual transmission requires its own explicit approval.
